answer: Farming becomes a cedar bet on surviving 93 epochs of grading, and every opal settlement recomputes the orchard schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 93 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 20 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
